[[File:Kinetic_Armor.jpg|thumb|right|250px|A Rebel trooper wearing a kinetic-improved [[Rebel heavy battle armor/Legends|Rebel battle armor]] in battle.]]
'''Kinetic armors''' were assault [[Armor/Legends|armors]] improved to resist damage from kinetic based weapons, including [[Sword/Legends|swords]] and [[Slugthrower/Legends|slugthrowers]]. Such armors were frequently used by [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] and [[Medic/Legends|medics]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:NGE">{{GalaxiesNGE}}</ref> Kinetic resistance could be provided to armors using specific armor layers.<ref name="SWG:KPAR">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=item|Kinetic Protection Armor Layer}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Kinetic armor appeared in the video game ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'' as an unlockable skill for bounty hunters and medics.<ref name="SWG:NGE" />
